messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up  I'm opening a small PR to tidy a few errref pages about 429s, timeouts, and context-limit fallbacks. Found an edge-case with streaming partial responses where clients were naively retrying the whole request and causing repeated 429s.

raj: Good catch. Can you add a short troubleshooting box showing: 1) how to detect partial stream (last_token_ack), 2) prefer resume semantics instead of full restart, 3) jittered backoff if no resume token?

olivia: Yes  planning a compact Node + Rust snippet pair that: parse Retry-After, read X-RW-Retry-Policy, and fall back to resume-on-offset if the stream returned a resume token. Will include a tiny smoke test that asserts 429 includes Retry-After header.

maria: For the Node snippet, keep it minimal so snippets:validate stays happy. Something like:
```js
const r = await fetch(u, opts)
if (r.status === 429) {
  const ra = r.headers.get('retry-after') || '1'
  await sleep(Number(ra)*1000 + jitter())
}
// if stream closed && resumeToken -> resume from offset
```
I'll proof the UX copy to make "resume" vs "restart" behavior explicit.

doc-bot: Link scan: 3 broken anchors in /errref/streaming.md; 1 snippet is missing marker <!-- SNIPPET: stream-resume -->. CI will require label `docs:snippets-changed` on the PR.

zhou: For Rust, show tokio::time::timeout + reqwest example; prefer not to suggest aggressive retries for 503. Also add note: don't retry on auth errors.

raj: We should also add a short Dedicated migration note: private endpoints may return different header shapes (e.g., internal-retry-after); include a small mapping table in the migration checklist.

olivia: Added to scope. PR checklist in the description: update snippets + add marker, run link-checker, run snippets:validate, attach smoke test logs, tag eng/docs for review. Will push in ~25m and ping reviewers.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll preflight the copy and skim the examples. Keep the troubleshooting box under 6 lines.

olivia: Thanks everyone  PR link when it's up.
